title: Part History records Tracking turned off and Tracking turned on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with nothing on hand: its only bin holds 0.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
  5. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  6. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  7. Click the part A row.
  8. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and part A reads "Not Tracked".

Step 4:

  • Part History opens. Its newest entry reads "Tracking turned off", with your name under Staff and today's date and time, even though the part holds nothing.

Step 5:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 6:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 7:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off.

Step 8:

  • The switch turns on.

Step 9:

  • The window closes and part A shows a quantity again.

Step 10:

  • The newest entry reads "Tracking turned on" and the one below it "Tracking turned off", each with your name, today's date and its own time.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S5-R11: “The change is recorded in Part History (S10-R22).”
  • S10-R22: “Turning tracking off writes the entry "Tracking turned off" to the part's Part History, and turning it on writes "Tracking turned on". A part with nothing on hand still gets the entry.”
